newsitem.title: CHINA: China's central provinces show fast growth.
newsitem.headline: China's central provinces show fast growth.

text.p: China's central region, which includes nine provinces, recorded economic growth 0.9 percentage points faster than the booming eastern coastal areas in 1996, the Economic Information Daily said on Monday.

The Gross Domestic Product of eastern coastal regions totalled 3.927 trillion yuan ($473 billion) in 1996, while the GDP of central regions reached 1.8979 trillion yuan and that of western regions reached 959.6 billion yuan, it quoted State Statistical Bureau figures as showing.
It gave no details of the comparative growth rates.
